messages:
alex: Heads-up — account NovaPay showing ~25% MoM usage drop and 3x incomplete onboarding tasks. I sketched a short "Tilt" retention play (save + controlled downgrade) below. Who can own and execute for an immediate outreach?

marisol: I can take primary. Need recent health metrics, last touch, and support ticket list.

alex: Thanks @marisol. Quick signals we saw: failed onboarding steps (3), recent support ticket about API errors, billing alert for over‑commit. Proposed immediate actions: 1) reactive 30min sync with CS + eng, 2) one‑month 30% discount if they commit to a QBR, 3) offer a downgrade "swapflow" that preserves keys and basic cache to avoid breakage. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/accounts/NovaPay (for context).

jen: Can we pre-clear an eng to join? Samir able to do the perf check?

samir: I can join 14:00 PST. I'll bring a quick perf snapshot — run locally: `rdw-check --account NovaPay --since 7d --summary` to surface tail latency and token cost patterns. If we see latency spikes we can recommend batching/quantization tweaks immediately.

lena: I'll assemble a 10‑minute enablement checklist and a short feedback form to run after the call (3 questions max: blocker, impact, desired outcome).

alex: Draft email (short) to send pre-call — please edit:
```
Subject: Quick sync to keep NovaPay on-track
Hi Jordan,
We noticed usage dipped and we'd love to help. Can we grab 30 minutes today to review usage, surface blockers, and map a short-term plan? We'll share a tailored downgrade path if needed to avoid disruption.
Thanks,
Alex (Customer Success)
```

marisol: On the downgrade "swapflow" mechanics I'm proposing:
- Auto-provision "Basic" plan that preserves API keys and most integrations
- Scale rate-limits to ~50% so they keep core workflows running
- Preserve KV/prefix cache for 14 days to avoid cold-start regressions
- Soft rollback window: allow warm-up back to prior capacity within 7 days
I opened a tracking ticket CS-4521 to coordinate billing + eng changes.

ops-bot: Ticket created CS-4521 by marisol — assignees: eng-tilt, billing — priority P2

jen: I'll prep a 5‑slide playback and the QBR skeleton (success metrics + remediation plan). Also recommend offering a 2‑week quota grace so webhooks/integrations don't fail mid-migration.

marisol: :thumbsup: Scheduled tentative call for 14:00 PST, invited Jordan + their engineer. After the call I'll update CS-4521 with notes and action items. Success metrics to capture: reactivation %, usage delta (7/30/90d), and post-call NPS.

alex: Nice — post-call checklist for closure:
- marisol: run the call & update ticket
- samir: post perf snapshot + immediate config notes
- jen: enablement follow-up + slide deck
- lena: send feedback form + capture NPS
If anything blocks the swapflow (billing or infra), escalate to eng-oncall and billingops. Reminder: we prefer retainment with a clean downgrade vs abrupt suspension.

marisol: On it. Will post a short summary here after the call.
